tools.name: search_icons
tools.description: Search Neat Icons (1161 icons, 4 styles, 24px grid). Use plain words for what the icon shows ("wallet", "arrow left", "hijri calendar"). Returns icon names to pass to get_icon. Each result says free: true or false. Free mode (no seat key): every icon can be searched, 201 free ones come back as code;

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: All Neat Icons categories with their id and icon count.

tools.name: get_icon
tools.description: One icon as ready-to-paste code. format svg = SVG markup, jsx = a React component, data-uri = for CSS or . Default color currentColor so it follows the text color. Free mode (no seat key): every icon can be searched, 201 free ones come back as code; the rest need a license (https://neaticons.co

tools.name: get_icons
tools.description: Several icons at once (same style, size, color, format). Use for nav bars, tab bars, menus. Free mode (no seat key): every icon can be searched, 201 free ones come back as code; the rest need a license (https://neaticons.com/#pricing).
